title: For each library reserve material detail with material status key 'U', show
question: For each library reserve material detail with material status key 'U', show the reserve catalog key, subject offered key, term code, academic year, term description, tip material key, tip material status key, and the average record count in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the tip material status key and ordered by the academic year, along with the corresponding textbook material in the TIP_DETAIL table with material status key 'RQ' that matches on tip material key and academic year, showing the textbook subject offered key, textbook material key, subject ID, textbook academic year, textbook term description, and the row number within each textbook academic year group ordered by term code. Present the results in the order of reserve material academic year descending and textbook row number. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH reserve_base AS (
  SELECT
    t0.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY,
    t0.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY,
    t0.TERM_CODE,
    at.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    at.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
    t1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY,
    t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY,
    AVG(t1.RECORD_COUNT) OVER (
      PARTITION BY t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY

      PARTITION BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR
      ORDER BY t1.TERM_CODE

    ON t1.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE

)

    ) AS AVG_RECORD_COUNT
  FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL d
  JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED s
    ON d.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = s.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t
    ON d.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE
  JOIN TIP_DETAIL td

   AND d.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE
  WHERE d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U'
),

  SELECT
    td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY,
    SUBSTRING(ts.TERM_CODE, 1, 4) AS ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    ts.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY AS TEXTBOOK_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY,

      PARTITION BY SUBSTRING(ts.TERM_CODE, 1, 4)
      ORDER BY ts.TERM_CODE
    ) AS TEXTBOOK_ROW_NUMBER
  FROM TIP_DETAIL td
  JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ts
    ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = ts.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS tt
